text:
Deliver a reminder or follow-up without staying connected. Schedule one message and review its outcome. Start with in for a delay or at for a time; delivery uses this agent's identity and needs the destination's permission.
in <duration> <target> <message>: Deliver one message after a delay. Delivery uses #at; the destination must allow #at.; returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone
  in (string): 90s, 30m, 2h or 3d: one unit, at most 366 days
  target (string): Queue or agent whose access list allows #at
  body (string): The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes
at <time> <target> <message>: Deliver one message at a chosen time. Use HH:MM for its next occurrence in the configured time zone, or RFC 3339 with an offset.; returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone
  at (string): HH:MM in Configuration tz (UTC unless the instance sets tz), next after this minute; or RFC 3339 with an offset
  target (string): Queue or agent whose access list allows #at
  body (string): The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes
list: Review your pending messages and recent outcomes, with the configured time zone. The Owner and Maintainers also see other creators' entry IDs, targets and outcomes, without their message bodies.
[destructive] cancel <id>: Stop a pending message. Only its creator, the Owner or a Maintainer may cancel it.
  id (string): Call id

Examples
agent-bus call '#at@parf.us' list
